main_body: steampunk street lamp / lantern post with rounded cap, glowing lantern housing, pole, and rounded base
top_band: rounded grey metal cap top surface with brass finial (rows 1-7) and rounded top surface of base (rows 36-41)
evidence: The lamp has a clearly rounded elliptical top cap (rows 1-8) with a central finial on top (rows 2-4), an overhang shadow at rows 8-10, recessed glowing glass panels (rows 11-15), a lower lantern rim (rows 16-19) with its own flat ring band at row 28-30, and a 3/4 rounded base showing its upper surface (rows 36-41) above its shaded front rim (rows 42-44).

style.evidence: The candidate uses a heavy near-black outline (#181820) around the top cap, lantern housing, and base, and large areas of flat untextured grey metal fill (e.g., rows 5-7 across the cap and rows 38-41 across the base), lacking the rich multi-step material shading, surface grain, and colored outlines of the Beodeul references.
